Contact Multidex

Email kunal26das@gmail.com. Include your device, Android version or browser, what you expected, what happened and the steps to reproduce it. Screenshots are optional.

Never send passwords, sign-in codes or card details. The support button opens your email app; it does not send anything automatically.

We aim to acknowledge requests within 7 calendar days and handle them within 30 days. These aims are not guaranteed completion deadlines and do not limit your rights.

Accounts and offline entries

Tap your profile picture next to search to sign in, add another account, switch accounts or log out. Swiping the profile picture up or down also switches between saved accounts.

Entries you have opened stay available offline. Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage removes them, along with saved accounts and settings.

Subscriptions and account deletion

To restore Plus, sign in with the account you subscribed with and choose Restore purchases. To change or cancel the subscription, use Manage subscription or Google Play.

To delete your account, choose Delete account in the account menu or Settings, or follow Account and data deletion.

Prepare a support email ↗

Opens your email app. Review the message before sending; no request is submitted by this page. Sending a message does not confirm deletion or cancel a subscription.
